visualCharacteristics.purpose: single promoted story teaser (Next Adventures) on the home page
visualCharacteristics.description: Full-bleed photo (640px tall at desktop) with a white text panel overlapping the bottom of the image, containing an h2 title, description paragraph and yellow uppercase CTA button. On mobile the panel stacks under the image.

contentPattern.structure: row 1 = image (with alt), row 2 = rich text with h2 title, description paragraph and CTA link

cells.name: text
cells.content: h2 title, description paragraph, CTA link

usage: Home page "Next Adventures" teaser (https://wknd.site/us/en.html): Climbing New Zealand, source selector .teaser.cmp-teaser--imagebottom.
reuseGuidance: Use for a single static full-width image with an overlapping text panel and CTA. For several rotating slides use carousel-hero; for a text-over-image banner use hero.
